DeleteWarning.zhs: 该操作不可恢复。账号将保留墓碑，凭据会被移除，全部会话会被撤销。
DeleteWarning.en: This action cannot be undone. The account record is retained as a tombstone, credentials are removed, and all sessions are revoked.

SecurityRecheck.zhs: 确认后仍由服务端按最新 Revision 与保护规则重新裁决。
SecurityRecheck.en: After confirmation, the server checks the latest revision and protection rules again.

CredentialSaved.en: I have saved it securely. Close

CredentialWarning.zhs: 这是唯一一次显示机会。关闭后页面状态会立即销毁该秘密，无法查询或恢复。
CredentialWarning.en: This password is shown only once. Closing this dialog immediately removes it from page state. It cannot be retrieved or recovered.

CopySucceeded.zhs: 已复制。关闭后将无法再次查看。
CopySucceeded.en: Copied. You cannot view it again after closing.

CopyFailed.zhs: 复制失败，请现在手动复制。
CopyFailed.en: Copy failed. Copy the password manually now.

EventsFailed.zhs: 安全事件加载失败，请稍后重试。
EventsFailed.en: Security events could not be loaded. Try again later.

EventsTargetUnavailable.zhs: 安全事件目标账号不可用。
EventsTargetUnavailable.en: The account for these security events is unavailable.

LocalAdminCredentialProtected.zhs: 本地管理员凭据只能通过本机维护命令重置。
LocalAdminCredentialProtected.en: Local administrator credentials can only be reset using the local maintenance command.

SnapshotUnavailable.zhs: 账号最新安全状态不可用，请刷新后重试。
SnapshotUnavailable.en: The latest account security state is unavailable. Refresh and try again.

DeleteConfirmationRequired.zhs: 请完整输入登录账号 {accountCode} 以确认不可恢复删除。
DeleteConfirmationRequired.en: Enter the full account code {accountCode} to confirm irreversible deletion.

OperationUnknown.zhs: 操作结果未知。系统不会自动重放，请刷新账号最新安全状态后核对。
OperationUnknown.en: The operation outcome is unknown. It will not be repeated automatically. Refresh the account security state and check the result.

CreateUnknown.zhs: 创建结果未知。系统不会自动重试，请先刷新账号列表并核对结果。
CreateUnknown.en: The creation outcome is unknown. It will not be retried automatically. Refresh the account list and check the result.

RevisionUnavailable.zhs: 账号最新 Revision 不可用，请重新加载后再编辑。
RevisionUnavailable.en: The latest account revision is unavailable. Reload before editing.

RevisionConflictDetails.zhs: 账号已发生变化：最新状态 {status}，Revision {revision}。请查看最新安全状态并重新确认。
RevisionConflictDetails.en: The account has changed: latest status {status}, revision {revision}. Review the latest security state and confirm again.
